memory_update.text: POWL should be tracked as a US-listed data-center power-distribution and medium-voltage switchgear beneficiary, but not as a pure dry-type transformer supplier.
BELFB is a lower-attention US-listed candidate for custom magnetics and data-center power conversion; materiality to AI/data-center revenue remains the key evidence gap.

PPSI is a below-$300M speculative exception with node relevance through packaged electrical distribution, switchgear and medium-voltage transformer-integrated E-Bloc systems; execution and scale risks are high.

Hammond Power Solutions appears highly relevant to the node but is TSX-listed rather than a primary US exchange listing; keep as a non-US-listed benchmark/pure-play reference for later relative analysis.

node: Dry-type transformers, magnetics, and power-quality equipment
summary: Expanded the universe for the transformer, magnetics, switchgear-adjacent and power-quality node with a two-lane funnel. Reference lane is represented by Vertiv because it is a high-attention, scaled data-center power infrastructure anchor. Discovery lane focuses on smaller or less obvious US-listed suppliers: Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear and electrical distribution systems tied to data-center power demand; Bel Fuse for custom magnetics and data-center power conversion; and Pioneer Power Solutions as a micro-cap speculative exception with specialty electrical equipment, switchgear and medium-voltage transformer exposure. Hammond Power Solutions remains a highly relevant pure-play node reference from the external context, but it is TSX-listed rather than a primary US exchange listing, so it is treated as a coverage gap rather than included as a US-listed candidate.
